correctness.rationale: Self-adjointness of normalized conditional expectations under the trace pairing gives exact Hermitian endpoint duality. Reduced density operators diagonalize independently on tensor factors; conditioning on auxiliary spectral selectors and Jensen proves the Bernoulli upper bound, and product-pure states attain it. The exact binomial identity and Gaussian/Poisson limits follow from binomial point masses and standard local limits. All dimensions, signs of weights, and zero weights are covered. The packaged checker validates 275 finite identities/inequalities, but finite tests are not used to prove the general claim.

This is a complete infinite-family matrix-operator invariant with genuine quantum versus classical content, not a mere numerical certificate or arbitrary finite slice.
